_comment: SupCom:FA LLM AI Bot -- Configuration File

_models.primary: Qwen3.5-9B Q4_K_M (KoboldCpp deep) -- newest-gen Qwen dense, native <tool_call> + /no_think, strong Russian; ~6.5 GB leaves headroom for the game + voice STT/TTS
_models.fast: qwen3.5:4b -- fast tier for Ollama hot-swap; KoboldCpp serves ONE model, so the 9B fills both deep and fast roles
_models.notes: Qwen3.5 has no dense 14B (gap 9B->27B). GGUF: unsloth/Qwen3.5-9B-GGUF or bartowski/Qwen_Qwen3.5-9B-GGUF. Fallback if KoboldCpp build lacks qwen3_5 arch: unsloth/Qwen3-8B-GGUF (same Qwen stack).

llm._engine_options: koboldcpp (default) | ollama | ollama_native | lmstudio | vllm | tabbyapi. Change this one key to switch engines.
llm._backend_comment: Legacy fallback when 'engine' is unset; 'hf_turbo' selects the HF+TurboQuant in-process backend.
llm._kv_cache_comment: Ollama-native only (api_style=ollama). Ignored by OpenAI engines (configure those at their own launch).

turbo_quant._comment: TurboQuant KV cache settings (only used when backend=hf_turbo)
turbo_quant._key_bits_options: 2 (4x compression, lower quality) | 3 (recommended, ~5x vs FP16) | 4 (2.5x, higher quality)

bot._poll_comment: Fast intervals -- 4B model is GPU-resident, ~3-5s per query, no game slowdown.

bridge._timeout_comment: 4B fits in VRAM -- inference is fast; 30s is enough for cold-load + first query.
